subject: ❓ [parked] rev: gate burn-down's TIER PROMOTION on demonstrated acceptance, not on token utilization — owner asked 2026-08-15 for the ladder to climb automatically from tech-debt paydown up to auto-crafted features behind a flag. MY READ: the debt tier is the safe end and largely already works (R82 ranks 1-5); the feature tier is not gated by complexity but by VERIFIABILITY — 'did I break anything' is machine-answerable, 'was this feature worth building' is answerable by nothing, so a flag makes it safe to ship, not worth building. And a utilization clock measures spending, never value: the binding constraint is the owner's REVIEW throughput, which does not grow with the token budget, so climbing converts a token surplus into a review backlog (the existing 3-branch cap is exactly this insight, already encoded). OPTIONS: (A) rec: keep the utilization forecast as the trigger for WHETHER to burn, but gate WHICH TIER on a measured acceptance rate — fraction of burndown/* branches actually merged; high acceptance promotes, rot demotes. Self-correcting on value, uses evidence the owner already produces by reviewing, and needs a merged/abandoned ledger burndown-branch.sh could keep. (B) climb on the utilization clock as asked — simplest, matches the request literally, and optimizes for spending by construction (burn-down's own header warns against exactly this). (C) hold the ladder at the debt tier permanently and never auto-author features — safest, forgoes the thing the owner actually asked for. CAVEAT ON MY OWN ADVICE: I am the thing that would do the generating, so discount my enthusiasm and weigh only the caution. PREREQUISITE either way: the generate-work path produced 3 real defects in one session (stale-input trust, self-referential ranker, glyph-blind work count) while green on 230+ tests — it is the least-mature subsystem and should earn trust before gaining autonomy.
